Graphics Presets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/be352d18e40f1f84bf35f4b2164c83c079901e1c.jpg

It took too much time to change in-game graphics on the go, so we decided to make this changes apply only after you restart the game completely.

Scene Loading
Added a Loading sign during scenes changing.

Ask before Quit
To prevent unexpected game shut downs, we added a dialogue that will ask you before leaving the game.


bHaptics Suit Support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/90d4c40f8de6b6d7c41819cd34b01ee4e66a135c.jpg

Finally, it's here! Big thanks to bHaptics team for giving us an opportunity add their awesome device to our game. Expect to feel the following events:

 Shooting with shotguns, rifles, pistols, smgs one and two -handed;
 Explosions;
 Head damage;
 Body damage;
 Player's death;
 Fist hits;
 Jump and wall-jump;
 Putting big weapons on your back;


Bugfixes & Improvements

 Gore: Removed visual face and body glitches after explosions. Now they deform models not so viciously;

Modders Community

You can get more info from our Discord and join Modders Discord if you want to take a part.

notes.title: Explosive Update Part One: Grenade, Sticky Bomb and Claymore; New Arena
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f143f904b7e4d170baafe954caa80696c774a92b.gif
Frag and Sticky Grenades
We made Grenades as simple as in any other VR-shooter, but with some physics updates.

Both types use the same control scheme:

 Take grenade with one hand. 
 With your other hand's Trigger button grab the Pull Ring and take the Pin out.
 Throw the grenade and you can see the Lever fly off and the grenade explode.

Notice:

 You can grab and move grenades for the Pull Ring. Rapidly pull it out to activate the detonation.
 You can remove the Lever with the hand that holds the grenade — press Trigger to set it free after you took the Pin out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/993aaa5ddc51fbe2c10d574198e369143350f1fe.gif

Sticky Grenade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a3af6b543a978d634aefe8a900735ab45bcce015.gif
 
Has visible indication that will start counting last seconds before explosion after you pulled the Pin out and released the Lever. As you may guess, these grenades will stick to anything, even to each other!


Claymore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f2df0e058f341f1b0335c75f61d2ef2fcf202732.gif

 Press Trigger to activate Claymore detectors and legs.
 Release Claymore where you want it to stand. Do not worry, it always lands on its legs.
 Watch them fly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/301763fbc3270dc93e9b1dca04d27f19a9c6e9e2.gif


Explosives in Ammo Workshop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c8e8aee847e6caecfb8b6df64b501f9a3feb3954.gif

We know you love Custom Ammo so we decided to tune how different explosives will work with it. And do not forget to set a limitless lifespan of those bullets or they will disappear after a while!

Frags and Claymores will be activated right after you shoot. Grenades will detonate after a short time and Claymores will stay in alert mode and explode when met with an obstacle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/31f8b17e09075d5e073ba047b3ecebe9c3470ece.gif

Stickies won't ignite instantly and may be stored until you shoot them with a regular bullet or remove the Pull Ring by hand.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5fd84f842c1fae164bfbccdda9ce3764fed0e7e8.gif


Explosives in Sandbox Spawner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/49d4d0c5eb35fa69510318ff017caea4cff911a1.jpg

Sandbox Spawner Menu works as usual, you will find new and future explosives in the Explosives tab.

To prevent Stickies making a total mess on spawn, a tip is to collect them one-by-one from a big sticky pile — use distant grab!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/69d00a4385e2684b9a1eab9d28166c9b419e2a5c.gif


Basement Arena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/2364c5c67f0ef7f329983f8e860e6289b901a3e1.jpg
We wanted to show you a new side of Hard Bullet experience — darker and more brutal.

This terrifying basement was inspired by famous thriller and horror movies and creates a unique dread athmosphere. What maniac lived here? What terrible tortures did he commit to his victims?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8a740285f1043f79c19c2e22c788310f730578e0.jpg


New Lighting
Added new lighting effects so all arenas got much better look. However, we got some issues with Streaming Camera on OpenVR devices, so for now it will show less saturated image than the player gets in game.

Everything is fine on Meta (Oculus). Working on Fix for OpenVR. Here is a Tip how to reduce this effect on Index, Vives, WMRs etc:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b008b44a3c239b9ecbe37b503654f382444d4496.png


Some Bugfixes
Fixed distance grab for Welding Tool and hand pose when holding.

notes.content:
Hi, today we rolling out some long-awaited bugfixes and Impowered Jump as a part of Player's Body Updates.

Latest progress allows us to smash those bugs that were here since we gone full-physics this summer. Say goodbuy to crooked aiming in slow motion, turning backwards body and a couple of shooting bugs.


Jump Improved
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8a3d12fe69b416611c1a7b873a27d6d4f953e065.gif

Now jumps are higher during runs and more powerfull in slow motion. Combined with wall jump, this ability can give you a significant tactical advantage during shootouts.

Aiming in Slow Motion Reworked
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4a1176d57601b6f064865bfc9f8c55653a4267e9.gif
Now grabbing with two hands in slow motion works flawlessly and nothing prevents your aiming anymore. Playing with your weapons during bullet time became easy and intuitive!


Backwards Body Bug Fixed

Shooting and Hands in Slow Motion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/dc46e2935d108c5d355ebb019eeccdf87d1a92ba.gif
During slow motion, fast-shooting guns like SMGs could push player backward and intervene while shooting in the air. We fixed this recoil bug so you can move as an unstoppable akimba through arenas!

We also improved the way you hold guns with two hands in slow motion and find this setup much more stable.


Some Delays
We have a band-news-good-news situation here.

Unfortunately, our Sound Update got delayed — we planned to share some first updates during November, but COVID realities got our partners, so do not expect any sound improvements till December. 

The bright side is — our team can devote more time for planned AI Updates, so stay tuned cause those guys will become more clever very soon!

SteamVR support for Oculus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4f0737e680c4caff3cc189f88803678af18a08d9.png

Greately improved SteamVR support for all Oculus devices. This should remove any possible issues Quest users had with controllers on startup.

We recommend to use native Oculus version suggested and official Oculus solutions like Airlink or cable connection, however, if you start the SteamVR, nothing bad will happen. 

Virtual Desktop: no launch options are needed anymore — just run SteamVR version. Remove old launch options from Hard Bullet settings! Hand poses do not glitch too, so you may need to set the offsets to defaults.


 If you choose to launch in SteamVR mode, game will start your SteamVR and Oculus will work inside.
 If you choose Oculus mode, game will just start with native Oculus SDK without SteamVR.
 If you have SteamVR already running, game will autostart SteamVR version.

Notice:  In SteamVR mode the Menu button is already used by Steam, so to open Pause Menu press both Y and B buttons at the same time.


Gore Settings:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b87b55a067cde47fc68fb856f5d47873dbc8b61d.gif

Now you can tune your brutal experience and choose what gore to show:

 Dismemberment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/7164ca7eef1cb457842a9d2f7233323ac5e80b44.png


Languages added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/642dc886a755b06101f531028fa1757bd5bdb8c6.png

During last weeks a few new localizations were added, now Hard Bullet contains 23 languages. Let's welcome:

 Arabic
 Italian
 Thai
 Vietnamese

We thank our community for translation help. If you have any remarks, please visit this Translations thread and find the best way to contact us.

Grey/Black screen for OpenVR explained
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/346c2e7f8ad7681e10716d7fa505ea185419d0a6.png

So after hours of research we came up with quite simple explanation that won't help those users who get this glitch, but will at least close this question.

New physics Hard Bullet was made on a newer Unity 2020 version and uses Single Pass Instanced rendering.

This particular model and Unity render we use prevent the game to work on OpenVR devices that run older GPUs. Basically every GPU made before 2015 does not support the hardware-based features we use in game.

You need DirectX 11.3 and Shader Model 5.1

So, as said in the minimal system requirements on Steam, you need at least GTX 1060 to run the latest Hard Bullet builds. 

Old Hard Bullet in beta tab uses older shader model so it will run on any videocard starting from GTX 770.

So what are we going to do with this knowledge? 
As you may know, we are quite a small team and are focused on polishing the content we already have and improving game mechanics. We won't include support of older GPUs in our to-do list, but will keep this in mind and if we find an option to change Shader models or DirectX without lots of extra work, we'll do this. No promises though.

Sorry for inconvenience, OldHB is still there and hope you'll be able to update your GPU (at least up to GTX1060) to get all advantages of those beautiful shaders we use.


Quick Roadmap
Want to share what's coming in the future updates and what are we working on right now. There will be  a Devlog post as we have more cool thing to show:

Improved Gore
New coplex gore system that will include more nasty visuals and also bring optimization to the puppet system. This will allow us to add new models and outfits to enemies much faster.

notes.title: Physics Based Update — Hard Bullet Reworked. New start for all.
notes.content:
Totall rework of original Hard Bullet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a2bae5e74cd89e9f06a38297e7b83447008c04c4.gif

It's here. Groundbreaking and innovative yet so familiar — sandbox physics experience that blends gunfights, cinematic effects, brutal melee encounters with insane tools and fun modifiers to create unique violent experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/11642902a19ee33e9830553d6e0183c27e640455.jpg

New Gun Physics and Enemy Models
Enemy's Gun Grab
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/580a0746d6b6ab02e8398209fa64b9194cee9564.gif
You can take enemy weapons out of their hands (some force needed though). Enemy holsters are not affected yet.

Gun Hold Physics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/d00df778e8fcca72a6f1b37745596720920894ff.gif
Hold your weapons for any part you want! This allows you to perform creative tricks, deadly hits, 
impressive reloads and brings a lot of realism into close quarter fights.

New Weapons and Layout
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1f1a6241adf8a14ab1a4d9d623a4f7fef03b7180.jpg

Dozens of new weapons are avaliable for arenas and sandbox fight. You can take a look at the full list of real world analogs for firearms and melee weapons we have here. 

We had to remove break action rifles but be sure we'll return better versions them in future updates.

Enemies and Gore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/cac0bb6f34564e7f40a1532f0aad5e6b1b6e7b5e.jpg

New models with moving eyes and new animations will make you question your sanity when putting one of those under a giant drill.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a63ab7764dbf30e0b1fe04769f6bebbd32a49e27.gif

Returned blood traces, added volumetric blood particles and endless blood puddles because it was not enought blood before. You can turn those On in the Settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4592d10aabd8f2f65a3c7c375148a81e1b96b0df.gif

New Sandbox
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/121124be14c3af5b5c4b327a329caf41919d6b8d.jpg

Now Sandbox has several presets in which we can better showcase game mechanics 

To make it easier and more fun for gamers and content makers we decided to include defferent locations into one scene. You can switch between different collections on-the-go and keep spawned enemies with you.

Enemy Workshop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/59c96f3685b8d6b457264499118aa0789f4f678e.gif

You can change enemies size and create true giants or dwarfs. You also can decide if they will stay immortal or will die from damage like regular enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/38c5d55976cfa353a7c5e2db32b94b991404c75a.jpg

Enemies with scale more than 1.7 will allow you to climb on them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/749c47789b88938cb85940ec5081b6b1d577bf38.gif

Ammo Workshop 2.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fa79804ef38d59e091243225861c1e22883b006b.gif

With this new Ammo Workshop you'll be able to create more crazy weapons of all sizes. Large pencils and micro pitchforks going to deal a lot of pain to your enemies!

 If object gets bigger it becomes heavier too.
 Firearms damage does not scale.
 Does not work with enemy limbs yet, will be added later.
 Does not work with welded.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/9aadf389a566d894aba49b8e6d3a969223a1a277.jpg

Welded Prototypes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e81882532bb54e91c29ea9c955176ec6698f9cee.gif

Results of freaky experiments, these hybrids are anticipating new feature that will come soon. It's not as innovative as others and probably you met welding in other games, but we'll try to bring it to a new level in the next updates.

Until then enjoy those shooting and cutting monsters we created.

Player Body and New Interactions
Player Body Physics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e77cb6cc4920b3ec11ef1183a05287d32ccd3754.gif
Player's body now has phisical impact on surrounding. It works so well, you do even not need to press grip to climb on some obstacles. However, we still have special climbing things so you'll have even more fun:

 Meat hooks on chains
 Rusty Pipes
 Big Climbing Scene in Sandbox presets

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8388b4790edcf42740b1a218aaa84aa1c6f54e0a.gif

To say more about new body, we also gave special attention how guns work with it. Big gun's buttstock should not interfere your aiming but will hit enemies as usual.

More Holsters
We polished holster mechanic so it almost never allows missclicks and always gives you the gun you wanted from the right place.

Now player has four front holsters — chest and hips — and one on the back.

Better Distance Grab and UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/799b9424906fe098bf1882c8e90e066558752f45.gif

So many new things needed new interface and user experience improvements. We decided to move closer to regular 2D layouts.

To make Distance Grab mechanic more intuitive we added more presets for better visualisaion of what interactable object you are targeting right now. You can tune how it looks in the settings, even turn it off completely when you are ready.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/61a54ea8d6d777f2dc449b71b48b90a1992f9113.jpg

Oculus Runtime
For all Oculus users added launch option, so if you have your Oculus device connected, game will ask if should run in native Oculus mode or with SteamVR support.

If you still using Virtual Desktop, you should select SteamVR launch, or just have SteamVR running before launching the game.

We recommend to use official Oculus solutions like Air Link or cable connection.

For all non-Oculus users: if you ever see such option, just select SteamVR launch, obviously.

Wide FOV Camera
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f8e363c95b31b2a0ffb6c40f1f47e2900aecac0f.jpg

We want to thank everyone who creates videos and helps us show Hard Bullet to bigger audience. Whout content creators we won't be able to bring all these innovative features and keep going further.

Hope you all enjoy this new feature!

Temporal Limitations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f68cfcfdb72c1acad492cd56e7133fa39dfa0cbd.jpg

We tried our best but still not all original Hard Bullet features are here yet. Here is a list of most noticable. They will return rewoked and improved — some are almost here, others will take time.

 No Soundtrack and lack of sounds.
 No Destructions.
[strike] Blunts do not deal visible damage to skin.[/strike]
 Basic Enemy AI.
 Inserted mags are not physical.
[strike] Most languages removed.[/strike]

Old Hard Bullet stays too
We decided to keep old October 20' - March 21' Hard Bullet available too. Due to new launch options it controls may have issues with Virtual Desktop streaming for Oculus Quest and probably with any other VR hardware too.

You can switch back to old version in the Beta tab, select OldHB and finish download.

Physics Beta is closed
Thanks everyone who participated, that was quite a ride. Happy to see so many new Hard Bullet users, please, join our socials to stay in touch!

notes.title: Dismemberment, Advanced Gore and Latest Updates Recap
notes.content:
Hi all! During last two weeks we've been bringing back features from the old Hard Bullet and reworking some according to new physics. Today we return one of the core features of Hard Bullet — brutal gore and dismemberment.

Before you start gory mayhem journey, let's say thanks to everyone who sends feedback and helps during bugs catching process! This community is awesome!

Gore and Dismemberment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1487e12740baae67c9b2ea9257e6c2016821571d.gif

Returned of Dismemberment and Advanced Gore.

A lot is still work-in-progress state and we have big plans on making more complex wounds and realistic visuals. 

In the Sandbox, the Default immortal soldiers are still immortal so get ready for some crazy gory situations. This is for our testing purposes, we are still in Beta!

If you spawn agressive enemies or visit Arenas, Soldiers will become vulnerable as usuall and won't try to get up when loosing their limbs. Nasty!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/0857ca4011ba5238098f67166d2c59d59fcf913b.gif

Gunplay and New Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8b4c518f7f834f1bdb636cd7f1636d867471f176.gif

Arcade Reload returned. You can switch in Pause Menu between Arcade/Tactic anytime.

Arcade makes it much easier to dualwield because it almost removes the need to change your magazines.

Just bring your guns closer to your hips and they will get a fresh portion of bullets right away! You still can drop mags with the button pressed.

Weapon List Updated. In Beta you can find a lot of new guns and we work on bringing more. Here is a List of real world analogs and inspirers of the models we use in game.

If you have cool ideas and want to see new weapons — leave your feedback on our forums or Discord.

NEW SMGs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/530d3f0965ee65e0c704120c101bd169ecd84c06.jpg

Melee weapons reworked
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a7fe7b05dab625a913de2a25c1f4b84957e1039a.gif

Сuts and cut wounds. Now shows more accurate cuts pojections than are in Main. 

You can cut, pierce and hit with different parts of the same weapon and deal different type of damage. This will allow us to add more creative melee weapons and show correct visual effects after hits.

Holsters on the front work with small melee. Big two-handed (spear, axe etc) are still in work and will be added to back holster later.

NEW BLADED
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8639c01f2736898963ba6b5be1de52878fdf8504.jpg

Enemies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f1e3b433fb18cbed72d3b2d6dac3894eeaf160c0.gif

Totally reworked behavior system. This will allow us to add more interesting animations and realistic reactions in the future

New Behavior: fighting with bare hands. They will try to avoid your hits and attack from the sides.
New Behavior: running in shootout. Now they can run after you and strafe while shooting.

FIX: No more snake eyes.
FIX: Enemy heads now better follow their targets (bodies still needs some work though).
FIX: Enemies won't shoot each others anymore.
FIX: Enemies won't spawn one on another.
FIX: Enemies won't fall when magazine slightly hits them.

Wide FOV Camera
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f8e363c95b31b2a0ffb6c40f1f47e2900aecac0f.jpg

Added special option for all content creators. Switching to FOV Camera in the Pause Menu will toggle additional in-game camera that is placed at your forehead.

Notice, this will increase your PC calculations and may cause visible stuttering. Make sure everything is fine before starting your Stream.

We will continue to add features for creators to make Hard Bullet a truly cinematic experience.

 Using VirtualDesktop? Check this thread to make it work.
 Texts in Menu are not texts.
 Only button-controlled magazine removal, no mag-hit-mag reloads or even hand reload. Only on button.
 Guns are unbalanced, hands on the handles may not fit into poses correctly.
 Hand pose may glitch and get unresponsive if enemy body disappeared when you were holding it —  restart the scene from Pause Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1d2db6a111db3ad2e137764082427675cb4d0e4e.png

As we start this Physics open beta, we count on your will to improve Hard Bullet and make it one of the best physics games out there.

We want to hear what you think about everything that happens, your ideas about future level design, weapons and enemy interactions. Find together the best ways to apply all these new possibilities that new Hard Bullet brings.

Use Steam Forums or join our Discord to stay in touch and talk directly to the developers!

Thank you all for your support, your comments, and for waiting for so long for this milestone — your belief in our small team helps us to move further!

Importnat: after switching to beta it will wipe the current Steam version so you'll have to download it again if you want to get back to old experience.

notes.title: Devlog: Blood and Gore, New Physics and Enemies Interactions
notes.content:
Edit from 31-05-2021:
Update will come on the 1st of June (tomorrow), still need a couple of things to be done. Thank you all for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/3f8cd9bd1126c83189bb64af639a643dd2c7eaa4.gif 

Hi all, it took a lot of time and finally we can present you new enemy interaction system, that will bring new layers to Hard Bullet gameplay. Whole parts of the game were reworked and are still in production, but it's already impressive how you interact with the enemies.

These new enemies will come with other cool things we prepared for the biggest update yet. Don't forget to check the other blog posts about it in the end! 

Various Enemy Outfits and Armor Amount

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/47eeeb354727c93d1bbdf95b3fbb8b0e1264052a.gif

With system like this we'll be able to make decent challenge progression in Rouge mode we are designing and give you more instruments for your own brutal creativeness in the Sandbox.

This is not just a cosmetics option — different armor types and weapon holsters amount will affect how the enemies behave and hold your attacks.

Gun Grab and Easier to Punch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/580a0746d6b6ab02e8398209fa64b9194cee9564.gif

Added this long-awaited ability. Now you can grab enemies' guns right from their hands (you can kick them off too), steal from their holsters or take away magazines right from the guns!

Eye Movements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a63ab7764dbf30e0b1fe04769f6bebbd32a49e27.gif

While faces are still in work (the current one is a placeholder), we finally added moving eyes to make those guys more alive. 

Right now it's more like creepy staring, but plans are to add eyeball micro movements, reaction to meele atacks and blinking from time to time.

We plan to showcase more natural reactions and all-new animations closer to the release of this Update.

New Blood and Gore work-in-progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/d6c7b720269db20e8032d97e9050e502fc18226a.gif

Trying to work out the best solution for gore on new models. We brought back blood traces on the bodies and surrounding models, so no more clean dismembered limbs or shiny dead bodies with gun holes! Expect more brutal effects in the future:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/7ac191d77dd84fe15a9df56b651899a477f88149.gif

Performance Optimisation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/04e439dc4a7519669ee5b8c9180577c4faa1249c.jpg

We try to improve every aspect of enemies and performance issues are very important. While we increased quality of enemy models — rised it from about 10K triangles up to 20K — we also dramatically improved CPU calculation effectiveness.

Reworked limb system, new animation system and better body rig gave sagnificant performance improvements. It's still a work to do, cause we gonna add more stuff and effects to enemies, but we hope to stick to this new optimised engine.

Right now the Minimal Recommended specs from Steam page can support up to 10 active enemies in test chamber. Probably this amount may decrease as we add more complex things to arenas in the future.

And about game engine — everything you see in these Devlog Posts were made with Unity 2019 version that eliminated a lot of Oculus and runtime issues, so it's fair to say that technically new Hard Bullet is completely another game inside.

Physics Progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4a3de735aedc5631518a23f9dd08cab456cef9c9.gif

Using grabbable pipe to move to the second floor, then using it again to slide down (slowing the movement with my left hand) while shooting from SGM from another hand.

notes.title: Big Gun Update: Firearms Reworked
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/42052abc8b7981432bbd6eee759022abbaa06641.gif

Realistic Firerate and Recoil
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/836def5c276b5554c048aedc6ab0ee0b68bcd3a3.gif

Happy to introduce you new gun physics system we've been working on. Some things changed a lot, got new layers and mechanics, so you may need to get used to them.

Firerate
Now the breechblock on every gun moves according to the real physics and moves the bullet into the barrel. The process inside the barrel is not visualised yet — we'll get there eventually.

This is a big improvement that brings us ability to control and tune the firerate of every gun in the game.

Recoil
As we have breechblock simulation now, we have a new force to handle with — recoil. Every gone now reacts accordingly it's bullet type and firerate, so keep your hands on them to stabilize and controll where you shoot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/17d21d6aa257e344ee68653af29b1a75c4d00158.gif

Gamedesigner's dream comes true
The system we created is a very very customizable so these are not the final solutions and final gun behaviours. 

Expect often updates in guns physics cause now we can change it on the go and no need to wait for next big updates! 

While we'll be bringing back all Hard Bullet guns during next weeks, be ready for small updates in gun balance and please, leave your feedback on the Forums or Discord.

Shotgun Reloading
We always wanted to bring badass shotgun reloads like in Punisher or Terminator to VR and here we are — reloading our shotguns with one hand in Hard Bullet!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/7c4aee97688c290ed93c6460b0965c8f87ee27fd.gif

Right now we are using a special control scheme to prevent accidential discharging. To let the pump move, you need to press and hold trigger during this reloading process. Pump won't move even if you shot the shell.

We are working on a second solution that brings classic pavlov-like pump that is blocked only if the shell is inside the barrel back to Hard Bullet. When this option will be added, you'll be able to select the way you want pump to handle.

Shotguns now shoot with several shots (pellets) so they have greately reduced range for dismemberment skills. This is more realistic and not so owerpowered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8d067fc8ddc6dbfdef362e7551d2807e41856157.jpg

Off-hand grab
Keep holding weapons for handguard to free you main hand. You can use other weapons, take pistol form your chest or just reload a mag.
https://youtu.be/rXritDDcSJs

Advanced Handguard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c88754af93e21aff4bc3f181e28f9035f5439723.jpg

Handguard now works the same way the hand weapons handles do. You may choose the best place to lay your hand on. But only one. 
Would be really cool to add a second hand grab too, we'll definetely look into this one day.

Break Action Firearms
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/28bd10d4b910e00022d53b8925aaeb7382f925f6.gif

Press Drop Magazine Button to open the barrels and you'll be able to put bullets inside. 
Enjoy this bad boy while we are working on sawed-off and two barrel beauties.

Tactic is now Default
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/87a0d643f55fb2f3982dc232264d66bc37cf55ae.jpg

While we still looking for the best solution for Arcade mode, we made Tactical the default one.

If you switch back to Arcade, it will affect only your reloading — guns will still get autoreloaded when you move them near your waist (as before), but you'll need to move the breechblock by your hand to move the bullet inside the barrel.

You can perform tactical reloads to avoid this issue.

Force Feedback
Guns feel new not only in VR but in real life too!
We added long-awaited force feedback to firearms types. This is a thing that will get improved and tuned overtime as new guns being added.

Right now you can set the strength or turn it off in the Settings Menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b4a8c57387768d0520eb099eac111ffa08f4a6f3.jpg

Demo Updated
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/35340777e149fb0af1a1760d223d7a9e8a795151.png

Added all these awesome features into Demo version. And removed AI opponents. We can't have both righ now, so stay tuned for further Demo updates and enjoy new physics!

If you want to remember how cool was just play Demo and kill enemies like an awesome action hero for zero pay, you can go to our Discord and get yourself a beta code that unlocks old version from 2020.

Or better just go buy Hard Bullet to support the development! It's not easy, you know.

UPD from 02/06

Rolled out a couple of important things today according to your feedback.

Changed handle positions for each controller type and for every gun. Should be easier to reload pistols and some rifles. 
Please, leave your feedback so we can learn more and use it during upcoming Player's Body rework.

Arcade mode got important updates:

 Pistols and SGMs: mag drops when gets empty. Autoreload works like it used to so you can go dual wielding.
 Rifles: You need to fix the breechlock before shoot again after doing autoreload.
 Shotguns: Autoreload works the same but you need to pull the pump every time. That's why we have those awesome onehanded reloads!


Other Changes and Fixes

 [strike]Guns you drop will disappear in 15 seconds if not taken again.[/strike] — ok, ok, they are immortal again.
 Removed "baby shotgun" bug. There is a voting on the Discord to leave it in the game — join and tell us what do you think!
 Nailgun is back in business. And have endless nails. Have fun.


Known issues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fd189c1964c85d90322a70dca52806f4b1b18ca8.jpg

 Made inactive some guns. Bringing them back during next weeks. 
 When performing reload with your main hand, magazines disappear from your waist — fix in work. 
 Buttstock on Gal and MiniGal stopped poping up when grabbed with both hands.


What's Next
During February we plan to do couple of things and get to the player's body physics.

Player's body here is not just a model but the way you move, how you grab and hold weapons, your holsters and even that annoying Pause Menu — all these things will be reworked in Player Body Update we'll start working on after we:

 Add all the guns that were in Hard Bullet before and add new break action models.
 Add new VFX we prepared.
 Seasonal Update for Lunar New year.
 Arenas refreshment.
 Add more melee stuff and maybe some new experimental weapons.

New Weapon Types: Blunts and Blades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8eb3f7bdabfb960e490fa8682ed8c0c96944f0c6.jpg

Prepare to cut through your enemies, pierce them with spears and pitchforks, cut with shovels, knives, machetes and traditional chineese swords to cut off thier heads!

Use taser baton or nailed bat to calm most annoying amd don't forget to put some guys on sharp spikes. Big arsenal right from your garage workshop: hammers, rusty pipes and other familiar instruments.

You also can use metal parts of your weapon to block enemy bullets!

We returned elbows to player, so you can do more hits and deal more damage in melee fights. We plan to expand this side of Hard Bullet gameplay too so expect more fighting mechanics in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8b91085a171c696ce7212aceed1c8cdbcdb87262.gif

Prepare yourself for new gory effects like blood streams from wounds, cleave wounds on bodies and new inner textures. Blowing heads and other limb coming next!

Improved the grab system, so nothing prevents you from touching them! And yep, now they look at you when get closer!

 New physics setup, gives perfomance boost with same effects and good ground for future optimisation. May cause some objects to loose weight, will fix it later.

Guns

 Greater zone to put in shotgun cells.

AI and Physics

 Enemies will give you less time and attack faster. 
 Returned blood particles from dead bodies
 Dead guys can't scream anymore.
 Enemies' bodies should not fold in half or try to stand up when you shoot them point blank.
 Updated destruction for wooden racks and benches.

Other

 Constantly looking for blinking objects and fixing them.
 Fixed Bug when hands were affected by camera rotation.
 Changed and updated lots of in-game texts.
 Fixed lots of minor bugs.


Thank you all!

And one last thing.

We want to thank everyone who tried Hard Bullet Demo during this Festival — we kept staying in the TOP5 VR titles all the week (and even got to the 1st place once!) — only because of you and your passion to shoot, destroy and kick asses!

And let's keep it that way! More awesome things to come!

Shoot, kick, destroy, through, jump, fly, push, blow up and — most important — have fun in this timekilling unstoppable action game!

Max Payne and F.E.A.R. -inspired gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b7fdf0f691b4d4fefad1099ee3b98d282b4de876.png

We always wanted to bring classic PC blockbusters feeling to VR gaming, so expect yourself to jump, slide, do wall jumps and all this in slow motion!

Made with a special attention for dual wielding gunplay so expect various submachine guns, pistols and shotguns. You'll find classic rifles as well.

Destructions and Physics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ff06c242693b888dc4dd10ca75d6988adc4854bc.png

Inspired by genre-defining classic John Woo movies like Hard Boiled, The Killer, Better Tomorrow, Hard Target 

We worked out the best solutions to bring realistic physic destructions and created dozens of unique assets to fill the arenas. Classic locations to mess everything up: offices, warehouses, laboratories.

Current Demo Limitations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/404c28e602f4aad36494bcc7113fcdc68655856c.png

Please, notice, this is only a Demo Beta Test and does not represent the final Hard Bullet experience.  

 No tutorial. Working on it.
 Weapons: No auto-reloading animations. No customization and limited interactions. Only a few types available.
 Enemy AI: Two enemy characters with a very basic intellect.
 Interaction: Limited character interaction. Object interaction is turned off.
 Gore and dismemberment are turned off. Blood only.
 Realtime lighting and shadows are turned off.
 Inventory: Gun holsters are turned off.
 Sounds: Most of them are placeholders or not balanced yet.
 Grenades and explosions are turned off.

notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The day has come and Early Beta is here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/d4dac9fc1f7588e16ec009d556013e5329cbb81d.gif

To get a Steam Key you should go to our Discord server and start a dialog with the Giveaway Bot.


During this Beta Test you can try the very first arena with two game modes: Waves and Survival.

Game has most of the core features, however, in the Lobby you'll find a board with more info about the current demo limitations and future stuff.

But who wants to read boring texts when you can go shoot some heads off, right? 

Go get your key right now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/9a303a89cb6a0c91c4336acba17ed3d05ccdd550.png


You still here?

For those who stayed, you probably don't want to use the Discord or want to know a bit more about the game before jumping in?

OK, about the Discord-only event — this is a test beta event we created because the original plans to release the demo during Steam Festival were moved to the next week.

So every one of you who can't participate right now will be able to try the improved Demo on the 16th of June right from the Steam page!

See you all at the Steam Game Festival next week!

Not an info, but a fact we want to share:

We've been working on a game where you could be a bad-ass hero and were aming into dual wielding playstyle.

However, the reloading had to be very arcade, so we created TWO different gunplay, modes for you to make your own [strike]movie[/strike] game story. 

Will you rush through the enemies with bullet rain or hide after covers and count every clip?


Again, you can get a beta key at our Discord Server.


Please, leave your feedback on Steam Forums and don't forget to wishlist and follow Hard Bullet Game Page to get the latest updates!
